notes: Subject areas drawn from the query clusters of the earlier NRW horizon-scanning tool, used as hints on queries and tags on reports. A topic says what something is about; it never says which requirement it bears on.

topics.name: Nature and ecosystems
topics.note: Biodiversity, ecosystem resilience, protected sites and nature recovery.

topics.name: Pollution of water and land
topics.note: Water quality, agricultural and sewage pollution, contaminated land and mine water.

topics.name: Air quality
topics.note: Air pollutants, clean air law and targets, ammonia and nitrogen deposition.

topics.name: Climate and emissions
topics.note: Greenhouse gas emissions, carbon budgets, net zero and carbon sequestration.

topics.name: People, place and resilience
topics.note: Access to green and blue space, health and well-being, and climate adaptation where people live.

topics.name: Partnership and society
topics.note: Partnership working, public services boards, community action and citizen engagement.

topics.name: Marine and coastal
topics.note: Marine planning, marine protected areas, fisheries, offshore energy and the coast.

topics.name: Soil and land
topics.note: Soil health, land management, agriculture and land use change.

topics.name: Public behaviour
topics.note: Public attitudes and action on nature, climate and pollution, from national surveys and research.

topics.name: Governance and funding
topics.note: Budgets, governance, audit and the delivery capacity of public bodies.

topics.name: Woodland and forestry
topics.note: Woodland creation, forest management, timber and tree health.

topics.name: Flood risk
topics.note: Flood and coastal erosion risk management, sustainable drainage and flood events.

topics.name: Water resources
topics.note: Water supply, abstraction, drought planning and the water industry.

topics.name: Biosecurity
topics.note: Plant and animal disease, invasive non-native species and the controls against them.
